note: Claude draft for Constantinople/Istanbul: dates for the OpenStreetMap wall lines, the lost walls (Byzantion, Severan, Constantinian, Golden Horn and Marmara sea walls, Galata), built-up area by period from Byzantion to 1900, gates with their Byzantine and Ottoman names, the imperial centre (Great Palace, Hippodrome, fora, Mese), the harbours and the chain across the Golden Horn, silted harbours, and name/kind changes of the best-known buildings. Shapes are reconstructions (conf 2) from the named sources; positions anchor on Wikidata/OSM where possible. Ottoman-era extents cross the Golden Horn and Bosphorus so that one polygon covers Galata, Pera and Uskudar (only land is filled).
